verdict.info: Traditionally a low-draw race but there have been outliers, with two winners from high stalls, in recent years. Those complications aside, the suggestion is \bBLUE BROTHER\p who is evidently thought capable of landing a big handicap, having been well supported at Royal Ascot in both British starts, and whose reappearance effort may well prove a springboard to progress. \bTribal Chief\p, who could find Jamie Spencer a match made in heaven, is second pick ahead of the Hannon 3yo \bBunyola Bay\p. The improving contenders \bIndalo\p and \bBeagle Bay\p command great respect, as the early betting reflects, while \bScoville\p is interesting and a couple of others hold solid claims.[Steve Boow]
